name: Boyd County, KY
findings: Boyd County has 140 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Boyd County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 6 union organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
